description: Mission control for your AI agents
summary: Luvus is a Rust TUI that wraps your terminal in split panes, live agent status (tokens, cost, context use, blocked/idle/working), and a bottom composer for sending prompts to specific agent panes without losing focus. The worktree orchestration layer—task queues, path leases, quality gates, and a versioned UHP protocol for local IPC between harnesses—is the kind of composable plumbing I was hand-rolling in PenguPool, but here it ships as a single binary with a `luvus doctor` command. The optional read-only web client with a TLS tunnel for phone access overlaps with what I built in AgentOn Pocket, and I appreciate that control is opt-in rather than the default.
